name: get_account
title: Show the authenticated account
description:
Show the authenticated account

Returns the account the presented token belongs to, so it also serves as a
credential check.

name: update_account
title: Update the authenticated account
description:
Update the authenticated account

Accepts name and the customer-writable settings. Turning tracker_sharing_enabled on
makes every device set to public — or inheriting a public default — reachable on an
unauthenticated URL.

name.description: The account name. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

settings.description: Settings to change, keyed by code. Writable codes: learned_routes_available, tracker_sharing_enabled, tracker_sharing_default, shareable_link_logo_mode, shareable_link_logo_file_id, auto_archive_devices_on_shipment_completion, default_stop_radius_origin, default_stop_radius_destination, default_stop_radius_waypoint, default_route_corridor_buffer, default_geofence_alert_on_enter_exit, default_geofence_max_dwell_days, default_geofence_max_assets, default_geofence_min_assets. Any other code is a 422.

tracker_sharing_enabled.description: Allow public sharing links. On, every device set to public, or inheriting a public default, can be viewed without signing in.

tracker_sharing_default.description: The sharing a device set to `inherit` takes.

shareable_link_logo_mode.description: The logo on shared tracking pages: the GPX logo, none, or the account's own.

shareable_link_logo_file_id.description: The uploaded logo file for the `custom` logo mode.

name: list_devices
title: List devices
description:
List devices

Lists the account's tracking devices, filterable by name, serial, status and model. Use it to find a
device id; `include=last_position` adds where each device is now.

name.description: Partial match on the device name. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

serial.description: Exact match. A serial is looked up, not searched. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

model.description: A device model. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

include.description: Include telemetry and/or last_position. Comma-separate values. Omitted by default because both are cross-store reads.

sort.description: Sort column, prefixed with - for descending.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, capped at 100. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Must be at least 1.

name: get_device
title: Show a device
description:
Show a device

Returns one device with its status, sharing link and container type. `include=last_position` adds
where it is now, and `include=telemetry` its battery, speed and whether it is moving.

include.description: Include telemetry and/or last_position. Comma-separate values. Omitted by default because both are cross-store reads.

name: update_device
title: Update a device
description:
Update a device

Changes a device's name, note, asset value, sharing or container type. Only the fields sent change.

name.description: The device name. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

asset_value.description: Value of what the device tracks, in whole dollars. Null clears it. Must be at least 0.

tracker_sharing.description: `public` makes the device viewable on its sharing link, `private` hides it, `inherit` follows the account default.

container_type_id.description: A container type id from `list_container_types`. Null removes the type.

name: list_device_positions
title: List a device's positions
description:
List a device's positions

Returns the positions a device recorded within a time window, 24 hours by default. Use it for where
a device has been; for where it is now, use `get_device` with `include=last_position`.

location_after.description: Start of the window on the time the device recorded the fix. Defaults to 24 hours before location_before. Must be a valid date.

location_before.description: End of the window on the time the device recorded the fix. Defaults to now. Must be a valid date. Must be a date after or equal to location_after.

sort.description: Sort on location_at, prefixed with - for descending.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, capped at 100. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Must be at least 1.

name: list_device_events
title: List a device's events
description:
List a device's events

Returns one device's events (geofence enters and exits, alarms, shipment events) within a time
window: the `list_events` feed, scoped to one device.

event_after.description: Start of the window on event_at. Defaults to 24 hours before event_before when both are omitted, or 30 days before event_before when only event_before is set. Must be a valid date.

event_before.description: End of the window on event_at. Defaults to now when omitted, or 30 days after event_after when only event_after is set. Must be a valid date. Must be a date after or equal to event_after.

sort.description: Sort on event_at. Prefix with - for descending. Defaults to -event_at.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, capped at 100. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Must be at least 1.

geofence_id.description: Restrict to events for one geofence. Must be at least 1.

shipment_id.description: Restrict to events for one shipment. Must be at least 1.

event_type.description: Event type (e.g. geofence-exit, alarm-sos, shipment-late). Repeatable. Must not be greater than 128 characters.

name: list_geofences
title: List geofences
description:
List geofences

Lists the account's geofences, the named places devices enter and leave. Filterable by place type
and ownership type, each multi-value.

place_type.description: A place type slug, standard or one of the account's own. A standard slug also matches its custom types. Up to 100 values.

search.description: Partial match on the geofence name. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

sort.description: Sort column, prefixed with - for descending.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, capped at 100. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Must be at least 1.

name: create_geofence
title: Create a geofence
description:
Create a geofence

Requires a location: latitude + longitude + radius_meters, or a geojson
Polygon / MultiPolygon whose rings are closed.

address.description: Street address, for display. Must not be greater than 1000 characters.

alerting.description: Send enter and exit alerts for this geofence.

latitude.description: Centre of a circular geofence. Send with `longitude` and `radius_meters`. Must be at least -90. Must not be greater than 90.

longitude.description: Centre of a circular geofence. Send with `latitude` and `radius_meters`. Must be at least -180. Must not be greater than 180.

radius_meters.description: Radius of a circular geofence, in metres. Must be at least 0.

geojson.description: A GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon with closed rings, for a geofence that is not a circle. Takes the place of `latitude`, `longitude` and `radius_meters`.

type.description: `Polygon` or `MultiPolygon`. This field is required when geojson is present.

min_assets.description: The fewest devices expected inside at once. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 500.

max_assets.description: The most devices expected inside at once. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 500.

allowable_dwell_seconds.description: How long a device is expected to stay inside, in seconds. A longer stay counts as dwelling too long. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 43200000.

place_type.description: A place type slug, standard or one of the account's own, from `list_place_types`.

ownership_type.description: Whose place it is: the account's own, a customer's, a supplier's, a 3PL's, or public.

name.description: The geofence name. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

name: get_geofence
title: Show a geofence
description:
Show a geofence

Returns one geofence with its geometry, place type, ownership type and alerting settings.

name: update_geofence
title: Update a geofence
description:
Update a geofence

Changes a geofence. Only the fields sent change; to move it, send `latitude`, `longitude` and
`radius_meters` for a circle, or `geojson` for a polygon.

address.description: Street address, for display. Must not be greater than 1000 characters.

alerting.description: Send enter and exit alerts for this geofence.

latitude.description: Centre of a circular geofence. Send with `longitude` and `radius_meters`. Must be at least -90. Must not be greater than 90.

longitude.description: Centre of a circular geofence. Send with `latitude` and `radius_meters`. Must be at least -180. Must not be greater than 180.

radius_meters.description: Radius of a circular geofence, in metres. Must be at least 0.

geojson.description: A GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon with closed rings, for a geofence that is not a circle. Takes the place of `latitude`, `longitude` and `radius_meters`.

type.description: `Polygon` or `MultiPolygon`. This field is required when geojson is present.

min_assets.description: The fewest devices expected inside at once. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 500.

max_assets.description: The most devices expected inside at once. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 500.

allowable_dwell_seconds.description: How long a device is expected to stay inside, in seconds. A longer stay counts as dwelling too long. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 43200000.

place_type.description: A place type slug, standard or one of the account's own, from `list_place_types`.

ownership_type.description: Whose place it is: the account's own, a customer's, a supplier's, a 3PL's, or public.

name.description: The geofence name. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

name: delete_geofence
title: Delete a geofence
description:
Delete a geofence

Deletes a geofence from the account.

name: list_shipments
title: List shipments
description:
List shipments

Lists the account's shipments, filterable by status, carrier, origin or destination geofence, and
pickup or delivery dates. Use `search` to find one by name.

carrier.description: Exact carrier name. Comma-separate for several.

destination_geofence_id.description: Only shipments arriving at this geofence.

pickup_after.description: Earliest pickup — actual once departed, otherwise scheduled. Must be a valid date.

pickup_before.description: Latest pickup — actual once departed, otherwise scheduled. Must be a valid date. Must be a date after or equal to pickup_after.

delivery_after.description: Earliest delivery — actual once delivered, otherwise scheduled. Must be a valid date.

delivery_before.description: Latest delivery — actual once delivered, otherwise scheduled. Must be a valid date. Must be a date after or equal to delivery_after.

search.description: Partial match on the shipment name or carrier. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

sort.description: Sort column, prefixed with - for descending.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, capped at 100. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Must be at least 1.

name: create_shipment
title: Create a shipment
description:
Create a shipment

Creates a shipment as a draft. Send `device_ids` and at least two `stops` to give it its itinerary
now; `publish_shipment` then books it.

name.description: The shipment name, often the order or load number. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

carrier.description: The carrier moving the shipment. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

asset_value.description: Value of the goods, in whole dollars. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 4294967295.

device_ids.description: Devices that travel with the shipment, from `list_devices`. Requires `stops`.

stops.description: The itinerary, in order: at least two stops, the first the origin and the last the destination. Requires `device_ids`. Leave out both to create an empty draft.

sequence.description: Position in the itinerary. Unique within the shipment; the lowest is the origin and the highest the destination.

location_type.description: `geofence` stops at an existing geofence; `circle` stops within `radius_meters` of `center`.

geofence_id.description: Required for a `geofence` stop. A geofence id from `list_geofences`.

radius_meters.description: Required for a `circle` stop. Radius around `center`, in metres.

name: get_shipment
title: Show a shipment
description:
Show a shipment

Returns one shipment with its status, devices and stops.

name: update_shipment
title: Update a shipment
description:
Update a shipment

Changes a shipment's name, carrier, notes or asset value. Stops and route segments have their own
endpoints.

name.description: The shipment name, often the order or load number. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

carrier.description: The carrier moving the shipment. Null clears it. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

asset_value.description: Value of the goods, in whole dollars. Null clears it. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 4294967295.

name: delete_shipment
title: Delete a shipment
description:
Delete a shipment

Deletes a shipment. Its devices stay on the account; to keep the shipment and stop tracking it,
use `archive_shipment` instead.

name: publish_shipment
title: Publish a draft shipment
description:
Publish a draft shipment

Moves draft → booked. Publishing an already-published shipment is a no-op
and returns the current resource (safe for retries).

name: archive_shipment
title: Archive a shipment
description:
Archive a shipment

Moves the shipment to `closed`, whatever its lifecycle status was. Archiving an
already-archived shipment is a no-op and returns the current resource (safe for
retries). Reverse it with POST /shipments/{id}/unarchive.

name: unarchive_shipment
title: Unarchive a shipment
description:
Unarchive a shipment

Clears `closed` and returns the shipment to the status its dates imply. Unarchiving
a shipment that is not archived is a no-op and returns the current resource.

name: list_shipment_stops
title: List stops for a shipment
description:
List stops for a shipment

Returns a shipment's itinerary in order. `stop_type` marks each stop as the origin, the destination
or a stop in between.

name: create_shipment_stops
title: Create stops for a shipment

stops.description: The itinerary, at least two stops. These fields use the upstream spelling (`type`, `center.lat`, `radius`), not the one stop reads return.

sequence.description: Position in the itinerary, unique within the shipment. The lowest is the origin and the highest the destination.

type.description: `geofence` stops at an existing geofence; `circle` stops within `radius` of `center`.

geofence_id.description: Required for a `geofence` stop. A geofence id from `list_geofences`.

radius.description: Required for a `circle` stop. Radius around `center`, in metres.

name: replace_shipment_stops
title: Replace stops for a shipment
description:
Replace stops for a shipment

Replaces a shipment's whole itinerary with the stops sent; a stop left out is deleted. Any change
other than a radius also deletes the shipment's route segments.

stops.description: The itinerary, at least two stops. These fields use the upstream spelling (`type`, `center.lat`, `radius`), not the one stop reads return.

sequence.description: Position in the itinerary, unique within the shipment. The lowest is the origin and the highest the destination.

type.description: `geofence` stops at an existing geofence; `circle` stops within `radius` of `center`.

geofence_id.description: Required for a `geofence` stop. A geofence id from `list_geofences`.

radius.description: Required for a `circle` stop. Radius around `center`, in metres.

id.description: Keep an existing stop, by its id from `list_shipment_stops`. Leave it out to add a new stop.

name: delete_shipment_stop
title: Delete a stop
description:
Delete a stop

Removes one stop and the route segments that start or end at it. The other stops keep their
sequence numbers.

name: list_shipment_routes
title: List route segments for a shipment
description:
List route segments for a shipment

Returns a shipment's route segments: the leg between two of its stops, the corridor width around it
and the routes it may take.

name: create_shipment_route
title: Create a route segment
description:
Create a route segment

Adds a route segment between two of the shipment's stops, with an optional corridor width and route
polylines.

from_stop_id.description: The stop the segment starts at, from `list_shipment_stops`.

to_stop_id.description: The stop the segment ends at; not the same stop.

corridor_width_meters.description: Width of the corridor around the route, in metres.

route_options.description: The routes the segment may take, each a polyline.

name: get_shipment_route
title: Show a route segment
description:
Show a route segment

Returns one route segment of a shipment.

name: update_shipment_route
title: Update a route segment
description:
Update a route segment

Changes a route segment's stops, corridor width or route options. Only the fields sent change.

from_stop_id.description: The stop the segment starts at, from `list_shipment_stops`.

to_stop_id.description: The stop the segment ends at; not the same stop.

corridor_width_meters.description: Width of the corridor around the route, in metres.

route_options.description: The routes the segment may take, each a polyline.

name: delete_shipment_route
title: Delete a route segment
description:
Delete a route segment

Deletes a route segment. The stops it joined are untouched.

name: list_users
title: List users
description:
List users

Every row carries the account-scoped permission structure. permissions.device_ids
and permissions.group_ids are the explicit direct grants only, not the resolved
fleet the user can see.

sort.description: Sort column, prefixed with - for descending.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, capped at 100. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Must be at least 1.

name: invite_user
title: Invite a user
description:
Invite a user

Creates the account relation and emails the invitation. An email that already
belongs to a user on another account is attached to this one; an email that is
already a member here is a 409 — changing a teammate is PATCH /users/{id}.

email.description: Where the invitation is sent. Must be a valid email address. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

permissions.description: What the new teammate can do and which devices they can see.

role.description: The teammate's role on the account.

full_device_access.description: See every device on the account. Off, they see only the devices and groups granted below.

group_ids.description: Device groups whose devices they can see, from `list_groups`.

name: get_user
title: Show a user
description:
Show a user

Returns one teammate with their role and their direct device and group grants.

name: remove_user
title: Remove a user from the account
description:
Remove a user from the account

Detaches the teammate and their grants. The user record itself survives — they may
belong to other accounts. Removing the account's only admin is a 409.

name: list_container_types
title: List container types
description:
List container types

Lists the account's container types, the labels for the returnable containers its devices travel
in. Only on accounts with returnable containers; elsewhere every container type call is a 404.

sort.description: Sort column, prefixed with - for descending. Defaults to name.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, capped at 100. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Must be at least 1.

name: create_container_type
title: Create a container type
description:
Create a container type

Names are free text; a name that already exists creates a second type.

name.description: The container type name. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

name: get_container_type
title: Show a container type
description:
Show a container type

Returns one container type.

name: update_container_type
title: Rename a container type
description:
Rename a container type

Devices reference the type by id, so they carry the new name with them.

name.description: The container type name. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

name: delete_container_type
title: Delete a container type
description:
Delete a container type

Allowed while in use: the devices carrying it are kept and lose their type.

name: list_events
title: List account events
description:
List account events

Returns the account's event feed across every device (geofence enters and exits, alarms, shipment
events) within a time window, 24 hours by default. Filter by device, geofence, shipment or event
type; a geofence's enter and exit history is this feed filtered by `geofence_id`.

event_after.description: Start of the window on event_at. Defaults to 24 hours before event_before when both are omitted, or 30 days before event_before when only event_before is set. Must be a valid date.

event_before.description: End of the window on event_at. Defaults to now when omitted, or 30 days after event_after when only event_after is set. Must be a valid date. Must be a date after or equal to event_after.

sort.description: Sort on event_at. Prefix with - for descending. Defaults to -event_at.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, capped at 100. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Must be at least 1.

device_id.description: Restrict to one device. Must be at least 1.

geofence_id.description: Restrict to events for one geofence. Must be at least 1.

shipment_id.description: Restrict to events for one shipment. Must be at least 1.

event_type.description: Event type (e.g. geofence-exit, alarm-sos, shipment-late). Repeatable. Must not be greater than 128 characters.

name: list_groups
title: List groups
description:
List groups

Lists the account's device groups. A group's devices are listed with `list_group_members`.

sort.description: Sort column, prefixed with - for descending.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, capped at 100. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Must be at least 1.

name: create_group
title: Create a group
description:
Create a group

A group is created empty; members are added one at a time through
POST /groups/{id}/members.

name.description: The group name. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

name: get_group
title: Show a group
description:
Show a group

Returns one device group. Its devices are listed with `list_group_members`.

name: update_group
title: Update a group
description:
Update a group

A member list in the body is a 422: membership is incremental.

name.description: The group name. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

name: delete_group
title: Delete a group
description:
Delete a group

The devices in it are untouched — a group is a container, not an owner.

name: list_group_members
title: List a group's members
description:
List a group's members

Phase 1 groups are device-only, so every member carries type "device".

per_page.description: Members per page. Defaults to 50, capped at 100. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Must be at least 1.

name: add_group_member
title: Add a member
description:
Add a member

Incremental. Adding a device that is already a member is still a 200.

name: remove_group_member
title: Remove a member
description:
Remove a member

Removing a device that was not a member is still a 204.

memberId.description: The id of a device in the group, from `list_group_members`.

name: list_place_types
title: List place types
description:
List place types

The standard types first, then the account's custom types, each group by name.

per_page.description: Results per page. Defaults to 50, capped at 100. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Must be at least 1.

name: create_place_type
title: Create a custom place type
description:
Create a custom place type

Adds a place type of the account's own under a standard parent, so geofences can use its slug as
their `place_type`.

name.description: Unique within the account, ignoring case, and never a standard type's name. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

slug.description: Defaults to the name in snake case. Lowercase words joined by underscores. Unique within the account and never a standard slug. Fixed once any geofence uses the type. Must match the regex /^[a-z0-9]+(_[a-z0-9]+)*$/. Must not be greater than 64 characters.

parent.description: Slug of the standard place type this one rolls up to.

name: get_place_type
title: Show a place type
description:
Show a place type

Returns one place type, standard or custom.

placeTypeSlug.description: A place type slug, from `list_place_types`. Standard types can be read but not changed or deleted.

name: update_place_type
title: Update a custom place type
description:
Update a custom place type

Geofences follow a rename and a new parent. Standard types cannot be changed.

placeTypeSlug.description: A place type slug, from `list_place_types`. Standard types can be read but not changed or deleted.

name.description: Unique within the account, ignoring case, and never a standard type's name. Must not be greater than 255 characters.

slug.description: Lowercase words joined by underscores. Unique within the account and never a standard slug. Fixed once any geofence uses the type. Must match the regex /^[a-z0-9]+(_[a-z0-9]+)*$/. Must not be greater than 64 characters.

parent.description: Slug of the standard place type this one rolls up to.

name: delete_place_type
title: Delete a custom place type
description:
Delete a custom place type

Geofences using it move to its parent type. Standard types cannot be deleted.

placeTypeSlug.description: A place type slug, from `list_place_types`. Standard types can be read but not changed or deleted.
